testProvenance.note: frozen, handed off pre-implementation; not edited by this writer

persistenceOwnershipChecker.result: kernel persistence ownership: current checkout classifies cleanly (build-time guard only).

capabilityDelta.before: createCustomerAppCore exposes only sdkCoordinate/status; the P13 cutover controller (createCustomerDataCutover) exists but nothing in app-core composes it, so it has no explicit opt-in entrypoint
capabilityDelta.after: consumers/customer-app-core/customer-app-core.mjs adds createCustomerAppCoreWithPersistence: reuses createCustomerAppCore's public-SDK-contract and customer:core fail-closed validation unchanged, then constructs a real createCustomerDataCutover from injected cutoverOptions and returns a frozen {sdkCoordinate, status, persistence} composition. Default persistence writer is legacy; construction never touches the pool; there is no automatic cutover; errors from validation or from the cutover controller propagate unchanged. createCustomerAppCore's own behavior and output are unchanged.
capabilityDelta.notRunnable: Nothing in this package wires createCustomerAppCoreWithPersistence into any live app entrypoint, config, or bootstrap; no live CreateCustomer traffic moves; no automatic cutover trigger exists. This is an explicit, opt-in composition point for callers who choose to build an app-core with persistence, not a completed migration or activation.

owner.once: Musteri app-core'u (createCustomerAppCore) ile P13'te eklenen gecis anahtari (cutover) birbirinden bagimsiz iki parcaydi; ikisini birlikte kuran hazir bir yol yoktu.
owner.simdi: Artik createCustomerAppCoreWithPersistence adinda tek bir fonksiyon var: once ayni guvenlik kontrollerini (dogru SDK, dogru yetki) yapiyor, sonra gercek P13 gecis kontrolcusunu kurup sonuca ekliyor. Varsayilan hala eski (legacy) yol; hicbir sey otomatik acilmiyor.
owner.fark: Once bu ikisini birlestirmek icin ayri ayri kod yazmak gerekirdi. Simdi tek cagriyla, ayni guvenlik kontrolleriyle, hazir bir gecis kontrolcusu tasiyan app-core elde ediliyor.
owner.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM formu 'musteri kaydet' dedi -> bu paket hicbir canli akisa baglanmadigi icin kullanicinin gordugu davranis degismedi; sadece gelistiricinin, istedigi zaman gecis kontrolculu bir app-core kurabilecegi hazir bir yapi tasi eklendi.
owner.kalanEngel: P14: bu yeni kurulumun gercekten bir live entrypoint'e baglanmasi, audit/outbox/idempotency parity, ve Kernel tarafi cleanup.

capabilityDelta.rollback: git rm/revert on the three writer files plus the frozen test; no DB migration, no P12/P13 file touched.
